viewpoint._说明: 画家视角：按原画估算（桌上的盘子、五个人的头和油灯对齐原画）。

text.zh: 从这里看，就是画里的样子。
text.en: From here, you see what the painting sees.

room._说明: 房间形状（米）：一间低矮、昏暗的农舍。左墙 x=left，前墙 z=front；后墙从 backLeft 到 backRight，右墙从 backRight 到 rightFront。

objects._: 屋顶挂着的油灯（房间里唯一的光）

title.zh: 唯一的灯

text.zh: 屋顶挂着的这盏油灯，是房间里唯一的光，照亮了每个人的脸和手。
text.en: This oil lamp is the only light in the room, picking out each face and hand.

title.zh: 这双手

text.zh: 梵高说，他想让人感觉到，这些人是用伸进盘子的这双手，亲自翻土种出了土豆。
text.en: Van Gogh said he wanted people to feel that these folk had tilled the earth with the very hands they put into the dish.

title.zh: 诚实挣来的食物

text.zh: 他说这幅画讲的是体力劳动，讲的是他们诚实地挣来了自己的食物。
text.en: He said the painting speaks of manual labour, and of how they had honestly earned their food.

title.zh: 一百多张习作

text.zh: 开始画之前，他画了一百多张农民的肖像习作，还有许多素描。
text.en: Before starting, he made over a hundred portrait studies of farmworkers, and many drawings.

title.zh: 不是肖像

text.zh: 他在农民德格罗特-范罗伊一家的家里画习作，但并不打算画出这家人准确的样子。
text.en: He made his studies at the home of the De Groot-van Rooij family, but did not intend to make exact portraits of them.

title.zh: 彼此孤立

text.zh: 画中的人是由几张单人习作组合起来的，所以虽然围坐在一起，看起来却有些彼此孤立。
text.en: The figures were combined from separate studies, so although they sit together, they seem somewhat isolated from one another.

exclusive._说明: 独家发现“只有一盏灯”：打开后，除了油灯附近，房间里其他地方都暗下去，只剩灯下的脸和手（spot.at 是油灯的位置）。

compare._说明: “三个版本”：任选两个对比。图片都要是公有领域；找不到合格图片的先不放（versions 里只写已经放进 images/ 的）。

note.zh: 版画是他用一天时间凭记忆画在石板上的，所以人物左右相反；只印了20张，准备送给朋友和学生。
note.en: He drew the lithograph on stone from memory in a single day, so the figures are reversed. Only 20 were printed, as gifts for friends and pupils.

title.zh: 第一幕 · 一场考试

text.zh: 1883年底，梵高回到纽南父母家。为了这幅画，他画了一百多张农民的肖像习作。他把它当作对自己的一次考试，想证明自己正在成为一个真正的人物画家。
text.en: At the end of 1883, Van Gogh returned to his parents' home in Nuenen. For this painting he made over a hundred portrait studies of farmworkers. He saw it as a test of his mastery, proof that he was becoming an accomplished figure painter.

alt.zh: 梵高《吃土豆的人》1885，阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆
alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, The Potato Eaters, 1885, Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam

caption.zh: 1885年4–5月 · 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆

title.zh: 第二幕 · 灯下的晚餐

text.zh: 1885年春天，他画下了这五个人，在唯一的一盏灯下吃土豆。他写信告诉提奥：他们用伸进盘子的这双手，亲自翻土种出了这些土豆。
text.en: In spring 1885, he painted these five people eating potatoes under a single lamp. He wrote to Theo that they had tilled the earth with the very hands they put into the dish.

alt.zh: 梵高《吃土豆的人》1885，阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆
alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, The Potato Eaters, 1885, Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam

caption.zh: 1885年4–5月 · 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆

title.zh: 第三幕 · 不急着被喜欢
title.en: In no hurry to be liked

text.zh: 画商和其他画家都不喜欢这幅画，但梵高自己很看重它。他说，他并不急着让每个人都马上喜欢它。
text.en: Dealers and fellow artists did not like the painting, but Van Gogh valued it highly. He said he was not at all anxious for everyone to like it at once.

final.zh: 他们诚实地挣来了自己的食物。
final.en: They had honestly earned their food.
